text:
ellie-customer: Hey team — customer (acct: acme-inc) reports streaming responses cut off after ~75s. Client sees partial last chunk and then reconnects. When they reconnect we see duplicate tokens billed. Request-id: req-9b2f. Repro steps attached.

sophie-support: thanks, can you paste the minimal repro and the headers? is this going through Cloudflare or direct?

ellie-customer: Cloudflare in front -> ALB -> nginx reverse-proxy -> app. Using HTTP/2 on the client. Repro (curl):
```
curl -v -N --http2 "https://api.redwood.example/v1/stream?model=gpt-open" -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY"
```
Start streaming, wait ~75s, stream stops mid-token, client auto-reconnects and resumes with resume_token. Server replays ~300 tokens. Billing jump on their account.

ryan-infra: Can you grab nginx access/error logs around req-9b2f and ALB connection logs? also what are the ALB idle timeouts and Cloudflare origin keepalive settings?

ellie-customer: nginx error shows `upstream prematurely closed connection` around the same time. ALB idle timeout is 60s, Cloudflare origin keepalive TTL 90s. nginx.conf has `proxy_buffering on; proxy_read_timeout 90s; proxy_send_timeout 60s;` App logs show no explicit error — it continued to stream (kept generating) for ~30s after client vanished.

dan-engineering: sounds like a half-close window where ALB or CF sent FIN/GOAWAY to client but app remained writing -> SSE chunk stays buffered at proxy and never flushed to client. When client reconnects with resume, app replays tokens. Two things: (1) proxy/nginx buffering + ALB idle mismatch, (2) HTTP/2 GOAWAY handling with Cloudflare can reorder close.

sophie-support: is the app using chunked transfer and flushing each event? any `flush()` calls? can you paste the SSE payload around the partial chunk? a short excerpt is fine.

ellie-customer: snippet:
```
data: {"id":"tok-873","text":"...partial output th"
```
Then connection stops. No final `event: done` or terminating newline. Client reconnect sends `Resume-Token: tok-873` and server resends from tok-400 onwards.

ryan-infra: immediate workaround: set `proxy_buffering off; proxy_request_buffering off;` in nginx for the streaming upstream block, and bump ALB idle timeout to 300s (or > expected max idle). Also set Cloudflare Origin Keepalive to match (or disable HTTP/2 in CF to test). Add app-level periodic heartbeats every 25s (a single `:\n` or small SSE comment) to keep proxies from considering the connection idle.

dan-engineering: long-term: we should harden runtime to detect client half-close and stop generation earlier (so we don't produce undispatched tokens), and implement idempotent resume semantics server-side so resume_token isn't blind-replayed. Also consider sending explicit final chunk/EOF marker regularly.

ellie-customer: trying nginx changes now. one-question: will `proxy_buffering off` affect throughput for other endpoints?

ryan-infra: yes it increases upstream concurrent connections/pressure; enable on the specific streaming location only. e.g.
```
location /v1/stream {
  proxy_buffering off;
  proxy_request_buffering off;
  proxy_read_timeout 300s;
}
```

sophie-support: labelled for escalation to eng-infra and eng-runtime. @ryan-infra can you own the ALB/Cloudflare config guidance? @dan-engineering can you take the resume semantics item?

ryan-infra: I got it. I'll draft a KB for customers: recommended nginx/ALB/CF settings + minimal heartbeat example. also create a runbook to detect replay billing anomalies.

dan-engineering: I'll add a ticket to runtime backlog to add graceful generation cancellation on half-close and stronger resume verification. also propose server-side dedupe on resume tokens.

support-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-8764 - streaming partial-chunk + resume replay. Assigned -> ryan-infra, dan-engineering. Priority: P2.

ellie-customer: thanks all — applying nginx change first and will report back in this thread after 24h test. :thumbsup:
